request: Add password reset token helpers: generate from email, look up email from token, and invalidate token.

summary.result_text:
I added the three helpers to `CTFd/utils/security/email.py`. The import check I tried needed approval and didn't run, so none of this has been tested.

- **`generate_password_reset_token(addr, timeout=1800)`** creates a random 32-byte hex token. It stores the email in the cache under `reset_password_<token>`, with a 30-minute expiry, and returns the token.
- **`verify_reset_password_token(nonce)`** returns the email for a token. If the token is unknown or expired, it raises `UserResetPasswordTokenInvalidException`.
- **`remove_reset_password_token(nonce)`** deletes the token, so the link can't be used again.

These match the names `CTFd/auth.py`, `CTFd/utils/email/__init__.py` and `CTFd/utils/initialization/__init__.py` already import. Those modules were importing functions that didn't exist, so the app wouldn't have started. I copied the pattern of the existing email-confirm token helpers.

I haven't run the app or the tests. To check it, run `python -c "import CTFd.auth, CTFd.utils.email, CTFd.utils.initialization"` and then the auth tests in `tests/`.

cat CTFd/utils/security/email.py && sed -n 40,90p CTFd/utils/email/__init__.py && sed -n 195,300p CTFd/auth.py && grep -rn "email_confirm_token\|remove_email_confirm" --include=*.py . | grep -v "^./CTFd/utils/security/email.py"
grep -rn "password_reset_token\|ResetPasswordToken" --include=*.py . ; sed -n 10,35p CTFd/utils/email/__init__.py; sed -n 120,195p CTFd/auth.py; cat CTFd/exceptions/email.py
python -c "import CTFd.auth, CTFd.utils.email, CTFd.utils.initialization; print('ok')" 2>&1 | tail -3
